strategyName: UTS-A Adaptasi Crypto: Donchian Breakout + Trend Filter

universeSelection.method: Fixed ex-ante candidate list; verify liquidity on the first 30 calendar days of the backtest, not on current turnover
universeSelection.survivorshipBiasDisclosure: The supplied market archive contains currently available pairs and does not include a complete historical delisted-pair universe. Selection by initial-period liquidity reduces current-volume selection but does not eliminate survivorship bias.

execution.snapshotCostModel: Backtest must use median spread and simulated sweep slippage from raw order-book snapshots. If no snapshots exist, the measured-cost backtest must stop; estimated-cost mode is explicitly provisional.

forwardTest.lateStartPolicy: Never fabricate historical runs. Actual start is the timestamp of the first successful deployed tick. Disclose the shortened period.
